changelog:
Initial release providing comprehensive Feishu operational guidance and team collaboration tips.

- Offers step-by-step instructions for key Feishu features including communication, document collaboration, calendars, files, permissions, and efficiency tools.
- Includes troubleshooting and best practices for boosting team productivity and solving common issues.
- Features a structured resource index to quickly find detailed guides by topic.
- Provides scenario-based examples to assist users in real-world tasks like project setup and collaborative editing.
- Covers both basic and advanced use cases, catering to individual users and teams.
